text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our Twinkle Series challenge alongside 
Mihono Bourbon had finally begun in 
earnest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The "Classic Triple Crown" was also her 
father's long-cherished dream. Overcoming 
long distances is essential to achieving 
it, but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's natural aptitude is 
suited for sprints. A fellow Trainer also 
warns, "Don't ruin her talent."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Mihono Bourbon calmly dismissed 
that warning. Just as planned, the two of 
them resolved to aim for the Triple Crown 
together.
